hook: Him and his dog Lucky, on a roof, in a flood.
narration: When the floodwater rose, this man and his dog Lucky were inside their van.
They climbed onto the roof of the van, [short pause] then onto the roof of a building, and waited.
A Coast Guard crew from Air Station Elizabeth City came in overhead with the hoist camera rolling.
The basket went down to the roof, and nobody was leaving Lucky behind.
outcome: The Elizabeth City crew rescued the man and Lucky off the rooftop.
title: His dog Lucky waited on the roof too
description:
After Hurricane Florence, a man and his dog Lucky escaped rising floodwater by climbing from their van onto a building's roof north of the Cape Fear River, North Carolina. A Coast Guard aircrew from Air Station Elizabeth City rescued them both on Sept. 17, 2018.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video by Air Station Elizabeth City, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/626635
